_about: Literals check_hardcoded_ui_strings.py allows to stay English, each with why. Generated 2026-09-16 from a two-round classify+adversarial-verify sweep; Android Kotlin entries (android/…) were added 2026-09-17 when the gate learned Kotlin; entries for ternaries, implicit returns, assignments, arrays, locals and bodies after a `let` were added 2026-09-17 when the gate learned to see them. Every reason starts with its category — KEEP_PROPER_NOUN, KEEP_NOT_USER_VISIBLE, KEEP_STORED_DATA (English data whose rendering is translated), KEEP_DEMO_CONTENT, KEEP_DEBUG_OR_QA_ONLY, KEEP_BY_DECISION — and the gate rejects a placeholder such as TODO or NEEDS_JUDGMENT. Shrink this file; never grow it without a reason.
